definition: machine parts fitted together as one unit
description: In a huge open-pit mine at sunset with red dusty ground, a crane lowers a massive shiny metal wheel hub, made of discs, bolts and gears fitted together, on chains. A young worker in an orange high-visibility shirt, a white hard hat and safety glasses stands on a metal platform and guides the hub with his hands onto the axle of an enormous yellow truck, then steps back. A woman watches from the truck, a big tyre lies below and a spare gear part sits on a pallet.

taps.phrase: to guide a hub into place
to step back from the hub
to look on from the truck
